abstract_en: A new ultra wideband (UWB) communication system based on parallel combinatory spread spectrum (PCSS) is proposed in this paper. The proposed system have the advantages both of PCSS system and UWB system, such as the high efficiency of information transmission and excellent secret property. Thus, the proposed system can meet the needs of efficiency and security as the same time in the modern communication system. The simulation model is provided and the performance is analyzed. The simulation results indicate that the UWB system based on PCSS has a better bit error rate (BER) performance.

abstract_en: This paper proposed a method to estimate sub-carriers frequencies of multi-carrier CDMA signals utilizing higher-order cyclic cumulants, based on the cyclic stationary characteristic of multi-carrier CDMA signals. Because higher-order cyclic cumulants can effectively suppress stationary noise and non-stationary Gaussian noise, through theoretical analysis, we can prove that the higher-order cyclic cumulant of the multi-carrier CDMA signal using BPSK/QPSK modulation only exist in the cycle frequency of sub-carrier frequency under the above noise background, so it can estimate the sub-carrier frequencies of multi-carrier CDMA signals by detecting the peaks of cyclic frequencies. abstract_en: Global Positioning System (GPS) receiver is confronted with the serious problem what is the bad electromagnetism environment, especially, the wideband interference. Currently, nulling antenna technology is the most effective way to reject the broadband interference. The FLMS algorithm of space-time adaptive processor (STAP) is developed for the robust array antenna, and is used to estimate the beamformer weighting vector adaptively with a low computational complexity. The result of simulation demonstrates the FLMS algorithm can well suppress the broadband jammer and improve the performance of GPS receiver.

abstract_en: A back-off smoothing algorithm based on mutual information for bigram model was presented. This algorithm not only analyzes the coupling relations between words from the perspective of mutual information, discounts the probabilities differently according to the mutual information of each bigram in the model, but also takes advantage of the low-order model to compensate for zero-probability case. In testing corpus of different domains, all the perplexities of the proposed smoothing algorithm decline more than 20% compared with the traditional Katz algorithm.

title_en: The Improved Detection Algorithms of Parallel Combinatory Spread Spectrum Signal
title_zh: 并行组合扩频信号的改进检测算法
venue: International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract_en: To reduce the influence of imperfect correlation characteristic between the spread sequences and noise in the channel on the performance of detection algorithms, two improved algorithms used to detect parallel combinatory spread spectrum (PCSS) signal are proposed. The improved detection algorithms based on cyclic correlation apply the cyclic correlation characteristic of PCSS signals to suppress inner-interference and noise as well as jamming in the channel. And the other ones based on multi-user detection (MUD) use the configuration characteristic of PCSS signal to improve the performance of the detection. The mathematics models of improved detection algorithms are provided and the performances are analyzed. Theoretic analysis and experimental results indicate that the improved algorithms based on cyclic correlation have the better performance to suppress noise and jamming in the channel and the improved algorithms based on MUD have the better performance to suppress inner-interference as the result of imperfect correlation characteristic between the spread sequences. At the same time, the complexities of the algorithms are increased that limit their applied occasion except for abrupt communication systems.

title: Adaptive Backstepping Sliding-Mode Synchronization of Uncertain Multi-Scroll Chaotic System
title_en: Adaptive Backstepping Sliding-Mode Synchronization of Uncertain Multi-Scroll Chaotic System
title_zh: 不确定多涡旋混沌系统的自适应反步滑模同步
venue: International Conference on Computer and Electrical Engineering
abstract_en: A synchronization method of adaptive backstepping sliding-mode control is presented based on the multiscroll chaotic systems with hysteresis nonlinear function and unknown parameters. The strategy is designed by a step-by-step procedure interlacing. At each step, a coordinate transformation, the design of a virtual control via a Lyapunov technique and the definition of a tuning function are derived, then, the globally control of the system is obtained. As a result, synchronization of the chaotic systems is achieved by controller. The synchronization error system arrives at the sliding-mode in finite time. Then, the controller can drive the error system to reach the origin. The identification of the unknown parameters is obtained at the same time. Because of using the adaptive arithmetic and sliding-mode control, the controller is robustness of parameter uncertainties and disturbances. The analyses and simulation results proved the effectiveness and feasibility of the method.

abstract_en: To solve the problems in modulation recognition of time-frequency overlapped two-signal in the single-channel, an algorithm based on cyclic cumulants used modulation recognition is presented. title_en: Study of GPS Adaptive Antenna Technology Based on Complex Number AACA
title_zh: 基于复数AACA的GPS自适应天线技术研究
venue: International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract_en: Global position system (GPS) adaptive array antenna forms null beam to suppress the interference in order to communicate normally. The nulling beamforming model is actually an optimization technique. Because the traditional adaptive algorithms usually obtain the partial optimum solution, in this letter, we propose adaptive ant colony algorithm (AACA) can find the desired solution which is a global search method. The article explains AACA and it can work well in the complex number space. Some examples demonstrate the availability of this algorithm.
abstract_zh: 全球定位系统（GPS）自适应阵列天线形成零波束以抑制干扰，以便正常通信。归零波束形成模型实际上是一种优化技术。由于传统的自适应算法通常得到的是部分最优解，在这封信中，我们提出了自适应蚁群算法（AACA），可以找到所需的解，这是一种全局搜索方法。文章解释了 AACA，它可以在复数空间中很好地工作。一些例子证明了该算法的可用性。

title: Study and application of FLMS recursive algorithm based on Space-time Adaptive Processing
title_en: Study and application of FLMS recursive algorithm based on Space-time Adaptive Processing
title_zh: 基于时空自适应处理的FLMS递归算法研究与应用
venue: International Symposium on Systems and Control in Aeronautics and Astronautics
abstract_en: Space-time Adaptive Processing (STAP) is usually applied to adaptive anti-jam system of Global Positioning System (GPS). It is the most effective way to reject the broadband interference. But STAP often dose matrix compute, which has a huge computational complexity. Paper investigates a recursive algorithm-Frost Least-Mean-Square (FLMS) algorithm. FLMS can reduce the workload of array signal processing and achieve real-time processing. By simulation, FLMS algorithm can not only well suppress the broadband jammer, but also suppress the number of interference more than that of the sensor elements of array antenna. FLMS algorithm makes it possibility that hardware achieves STAP.
abstract_zh: 空时自适应处理(STAP)通常应用于全球定位系统(GPS)的自适应抗干扰系统。这是抑制宽带干扰最有效的方法。但STAP经常进行矩阵计算，计算复杂度巨大。论文研究了一种递归算法——Frost最小均方（FLMS）算法。 FLMS可以减少阵列信号处理的工作量，实现实时处理。通过仿真发现，FLMS算法不仅能够很好地抑制宽带干扰，而且抑制的干扰数量比阵列天线传感器单元的干扰数量还要多。 FLMS算法使硬件实现STAP成为可能。

title: Study and simulating of adaptive array processing with effect of channel uniformity
title_en: Study and simulating of adaptive array processing with effect of channel uniformity
title_zh: 通道均匀性影响的自适应阵列处理研究与仿真
venue: International Symposium on Systems and Control in Aeronautics and Astronautics
abstract_en: Adaptive anti-jam processing used by Global Positioning System (GPS) usually works in an environment where interferences exist. The Power-Inversion (PI) algorithm is often applied to suppress interferences in the system. But variance of amplitude and phase which exists among antenna channel takes bad effect on adaptive anti-jam processing and PI algorithm, so we do our best to research the relation between channel uniformity and adaptive processing. When variance of amplitude and phase is limited under the definite condition, paper proves PI algorithm can not only reject interferences, but also conquer channel uniformity on a certain degree by academic researching and simulating. The conclusion has the advantage to engineering applications.
abstract_zh: 全球定位系统（GPS）使用的自适应抗干扰处理通常工作在存在干扰的环境中。功率反转（PI）算法通常用于抑制系统中的干扰。但天线通道之间存在的幅度和相位的方差对自适应抗干扰处理和PI算法产生了不良影响，因此我们尽力研究通道均匀性与自适应处理之间的关系。在一定条件下，当幅度和相位的方差受到限制时，本文通过学术研究和仿真证明PI算法不仅可以抑制干扰，而且可以在一定程度上克服信道的均匀性。该结论有利于工程应用。

title: ZF Code-Aided Narrow-Band Interference Suppression for Synchronous DS-CDMA Systems
title_en: ZF Code-Aided Narrow-Band Interference Suppression for Synchronous DS-CDMA Systems
title_zh: 同步 DS-CDMA 系统的 ZF 编码辅助窄带干扰抑制
venue: International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract_en: This paper analyzes zero-forcing (ZF) code-aided narrow-band interference (NBI) rejection in synchronous direct-sequence code-division multiple access (DS-CDMA) systems of complex channel circumstance. The performance of decoding is badly affected based on general ZF code-aided techniques because of the phase of complex gain accounting for channel effects. The system based on modified ZF code-aided technique could cancellate or relieve the effects but attend by high computational complexity. So this paper designs a new optimal restrictive ZF code-aided technique to solve this problem without the increasing of computational complexity. The conclusion is approved by experiments.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了复杂信道环境下同步直接序列码分多址(DS-CDMA)系统中的迫零(ZF)码辅助窄带干扰(NBI)抑制。由于考虑信道效应的复杂增益的相位，基于一般ZF编码辅助技术的解码性能受到严重影响。基于改进的ZF代码辅助技术的系统可以消除或减轻影响，但计算复杂度较高。因此，本文设计了一种新的最优限制性ZF代码辅助技术来解决该问题，而无需增加计算复杂度。该结论经实验验证。

abstract_en: This paper presents a novel composite parallel combinatory spread spectrum (CPC/SS) communication system. CPC/SS system can be designed to have more higher data transmission capability than spread spectrum (SS) communication system, even several times on Gaussian channels compared to ordinary parallel combinatory spread spectrum (PC/SS) system. In the proposed system, modulation of position code and state are applied to each simultaneously transmitting PN sequences. The symbol error rate and average bit error rate are analyzed to evaluate the performance of the proposed systems. abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新型复合并行组合扩频（CPC/SS）通信系统。 CPC/SS系统可以设计成比扩频(SS)通信系统具有更高的数据传输能力，甚至在高斯信道上比普通并行组合扩频(PC/SS)系统高数倍。在所提出的系统中，位置码和状态的调制被应用于每个同时传输的PN序列。分析符号错误率和平均误码率以评估所提出系统的性能。此外，CPC/SS系统比PC/SS和CDMA通信系统具有优良的保密性。

The scheme utilizes dual phase-shifted fiber gratings to modulate frequency when the interferometric light of different frequency pass photoconductive photodetector weeny light heterodyne frequency switch highly electronic frequency and proceed to frequency response test and matching. We can proceed to match design of total system optical frequency characteristic according as component frequency characteristic matching adjustment. Compared with conventional scheme that the variety of regulable optical cavity length obtains beat frequency signal in the photoconductive photodetector, the scheme can proceed to exceed broad band frequency response characteristic test to photoconductive photodetector and total communication system without additional calibrate light source and the scheme possess quantitative control and narrow line breadth of laser signal less polarization so that highly precision of test and distinguishability. abstract_en: The main disadvantage of OFDM system is the high ratio of Peak to Average Power,which is usually concluded to PAPR problem.To solve the problem,it is necessary for the part in the system to posses a high linear dynamic range,on the purpose to avoid the spectrum diffuse caused by the signal distortion,and the miscoding rate increase caused by the band-in distortion,thereby the complexity of the design and the cost will be increased.To take the problems of engineering implementation complexity and the resources utilization into consideration,a novel chip design method is studied to reduce the PAPR of OFDM signals using the OFDM technique in medium-voltage power line communication.This design not only costs less expense but also efficiently lowers the PAPR,and is as well as easy to be implemented.
abstract_zh: OFDM系统的主要缺点是峰均功率比过高,通常归结为PAPR问题。为了解决这个问题,需要系统中的部分具有较高的线性动态范围,以避免信号失真引起的频谱扩散和带内失真引起的误码率增加,从而增加设计复杂度和成本。针对工程实现复杂度和资源利用率问题,研究了一种新的芯片设计方法,以降低利用中压电力线通信中的 OFDM 技术进行 OFDM 信号的 PAPR。该设计不仅成本较低，而且可以有效地降低成本。

title_zh: MIMO系统天线阵列空间相关性分析
venue: International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract_en: In this paper, the spatial correlation analysis was based on a circular antenna arrays. The antenna was placed on the circle equably. So, the distance between antenna elements was considered in the analysis. At the same time, the formula of spatial correlation at the receiver was educed, which was aimed at circular antenna arrays. The correlation between antenna elements changed due to the changed antenna distance, the angle spread and the average angle of arrival direction of the signal. The antenna correlation changed with the angle spread changed. At this paper, the equality distributing of angle spread was considered. Each parameter that influenced spatial correlation was analyzed, the simulation figure demo the results derived by the formula. It was important to the analysis of the MIMO systems estimation and design.
abstract_zh: 本文基于圆形天线阵列进行空间相关分析。 The antenna was placed on the circle equably.因此，在分析中考虑了天线元件之间的距离。同时，针对圆形天线阵，推导了接收机处空间相关性的计算公式。由于天线距离、角度扩展和信号到达方向的平均角度的变化，天线单元之间的相关性发生变化。天线相关性随着角度扩展的变化而变化。本文考虑了角展度的均匀分布。分析了影响空间相关性的每个参数，仿真图演示了该函数得出的结果...

title: Optical taper of polymer optical fiber used in laser communication system
title_en: Optical taper of polymer optical fiber used in laser communication system
title_zh: 激光通信系统用聚合物光纤光锥
venue: Proceedings of SPIE, the International Society for Optical Engineering/Proceedings of SPIE
abstract_en: The key technique of optical wireless communication is Acquisition, Pointing and Tracking (APT). Owing to very large distance of optical wireless communication, all these factors such as equipment joggling, the scintillation will cause drift of facula. Traditional solution consists of acquisition system and tracking and pointing system. The acquisition system means that the acquisition of target in large scope of range of response. The tracking and pointing system means that accurate pointing to the communicative target. The function of system is to accurately point the target and to real-time track it after the acquisition of the target. This paper presents an innovative solution. The main idea proposed in this paper is to take the diameter of the light beam emitted by the optical taper in control, using the piezoelectric ceramic to adjust the smaller diameter of the optical taper of polymer optical fiber. This can make the facula larger when the system proceed to acquire and track, and make it smaller when the system proceed to communicate. The larger the facula is, the lower the energy density and SNR become. However, because of the lower precision requirement of information in tracking than in communication, the technique can fulfill the request generally. Meanwhile, the adopting of the OCDMA technique can greatly reduce the power request of the laser equipment. This new technique combines the communication system and the beacon system together, resulting in the smart decrease in the equipment price and the sharp simplification in the system scale.

title: Research on the expansion technology of the single-moderadiation frequency band of leaky coaxial cable
title_en: Research on the expansion technology of the single-moderadiation frequency band of leaky coaxial cable
title_zh: 漏泄同轴电缆单模辐射频段扩展技术研究
abstract_en: By analyzing the modes of the radiation of leaky coaxial cable using Floquet Theorem,the condition of the single-mode radiation is obtained.Then,the restraint of high-order mode radiation is examined,and the particular methods to realize the frequency expansion of the single-mode radiation of leaky coaxial cable with vertical and inclined slots are discussed respectively.These methods provide a basis for the application of leaky coaxial cable to the broadband communication.
abstract_zh: 利用Floquet定理对漏泄同轴电缆的辐射模式进行分析，得到了单模辐射的条件，然后考察了高次模辐射的抑制，并分别讨论了垂直槽和倾斜槽实现漏泄同轴电缆单模辐射频率扩展的具体方法。这些方法为漏泄同轴电缆在宽带通信中的应用提供了基础。

title: Research on the Radiation Characteristics of Leaky Coaxial Cable and Spiral Antenna in the Blind Zone
title_en: Research on the Radiation Characteristics of Leaky Coaxial Cable and Spiral Antenna in the Blind Zone
title_zh: 漏泄同轴电缆和螺旋天线盲区辐射特性研究
venue: International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract_en: As an instrument to realize mobile communication in the blind zone, leaky coaxial cable (LCX) is recently widely used in communication systems of tunnels, mines, subways and so on. In this paper, beginning with the radiation theory of LCX and antenna, by the use of ray-tracing method, we take a tunnel for example to analyze its radiated field produced by both LCX and spiral antenna. By comparison, LCX shows advantages in the coverage of the radiated field in such special areas-the distribution of the radiated field is more uniform. The theories and results in this paper can be extended in other blind zones and have referenced values in further research on solving the problems of communication in the blind zone
abstract_zh: 漏泄同轴电缆(LCX)作为实现盲区移动通信的工具，近年来被广泛应用于隧道、矿井、地铁等通信系统中。本文从LCX和天线的辐射理论出发，利用射线追踪方法，以隧道为例，分析了LCX和螺旋天线产生的辐射场。相比之下，LCX在此类特殊区域的辐射场覆盖方面表现出优势——辐射场分布更均匀。本文的理论和结果可以推广到其他盲区，对进一步研究解决盲区通信问题具有参考价值

title: Research on the Radiated Field's Distribution of Leaky Coaxial Cable in the Blind Zone
title_en: Research on the Radiated Field's Distribution of Leaky Coaxial Cable in the Blind Zone
title_zh: 漏泄同轴电缆盲区辐射场分布研究
venue: International Symposium on Systems and Control in Aeronautics and Astronautics
abstract_en: The path of electric waves of leaky coaxial cable (LCX) in the blind zone is analyzed in the ray-tracing method on the assumption that the bind zone is rectangular, and the distribution of the radiated field in the blind zone is calculated. Further, the effect of the period of the slots of LCX on the magnitude fluctuation is also discussed: a proper period can decrease the magnitude fluctuation of the radiated field. The method used in this paper can be generalized in other zones with different shapes. The theoretical basis is provided for the application of LCX in the blind zone
abstract_zh: 在假设束缚区为矩形的情况下，采用射线追迹法对盲区漏泄同轴电缆（LCX）的电波路径进行分析，计算盲区内辐射场的分布。进一步地，还讨论了LCX时隙的周期对幅值波动的影响：适当的周期可以减小辐射场幅值波动。本文使用的方法可以推广到其他不同形状的区域。为LCX在盲区的应用提供理论依据

title: Narrow-Band Interference Suppression in DSSS Using Adaptive Least-Square Lattice Interpolators
title_en: Narrow-Band Interference Suppression in DSSS Using Adaptive Least-Square Lattice Interpolators
title_zh: 使用自适应最小二乘点阵插值器抑制 DSSS 中的窄带干扰
abstract_en: To improve the validity of narrow-band interference (NBI) suppression in DSSS, this paper uses LSL interpolators as the NBI suppression algorithms which are based on the method of least-squares and lattice structure. Utilizing the discrepancy in the predictability between NBI and the spread spectrum (SS) signal, a linear interpolation of the received signal can so accurately estimate NBI in the input signal of the receiver and suppress it availably. The convergence rate and robustness performance of LSL interpolators outperforms ones of LSL predictors, because the former fully utilizes the correlation characteristic of signal samples. It was shown that it can obtain more 3 dB~6 dB process gain than LSL predictors
abstract_zh: 为了提高DSSS中窄带干扰(NBI)抑制的有效性，本文采用基于最小二乘法和格结构的LSL插值器作为NBI抑制算法。利用NBI和扩频(SS)信号之间的可预测性差异，接收信号的线性插值可以准确地估计接收机输入信号中的NBI并有效地抑制它。 LSL插值器的收敛速度和鲁棒性性能优于LSL预测器，因为前者充分利用了信号样本的相关特性。结果表明，它比LSL预测器可以获得更多3 dB~6 dB的过程增益

title: An Improved LSL Interpolator to Suppress Narrow-Band Interference forDirect-Sequence Spread-Spectrum Systems
title_en: An Improved LSL Interpolator to Suppress Narrow-Band Interference forDirect-Sequence Spread-Spectrum Systems
title_zh: 一种改进的 LSL 内插器来抑制直接序列扩频系统的窄带干扰
venue: International Conference on Communications and Networking in China (ChinaCom)
abstract_en: An improved interpolator based on QR-decomposition is proposed to suppress narrow-band interference (NBI) in direct-sequence spread-spectrum (DS/SS) systems. This interpolator is based on the discrepancy in the predictability between NBI and the spread spectrum signal (SS), and then uses a linear interpolation of the received signal to estimate NBI. Because of QR-decomposition operation instead of inverting the correlation matrix and a novel variable with a small dynamic range, the performances of QRD-LSL interpolators outperform ones of LSL predictors and LSL interpolators. It was shown that the QRD-LSL interpolators can obtain more 4 dB processing gain than LSL predictors and LSL predictors, and its total computational complexity scales linearly with the interpolation order.
abstract_zh: 提出了一种基于 QR 分解的改进插值器来抑制直接序列扩频 (DS/SS) 系统中的窄带干扰 (NBI)。该插值器基于 NBI 和扩频信号 (SS) 之间的可预测性差异，然后使用接收信号的线性插值来估计 NBI。由于 QR 分解操作而不是求逆相关矩阵以及动态范围较小的新颖变量，QRD-LSL 插值器的性能优于 LSL 预测器和 LSL 插值器。结果表明，QRD-LSL 插值器可以获得比 LSL 预测器和 LSL 预测器多 4 dB 的处理增益，并且其总计算复杂度为 L...

title: Design of FIR filter with Matlab and running on FPGA
title_en: Design of FIR filter with Matlab and running on FPGA
title_zh: FIR滤波器的Matlab设计并在FPGA上运行
abstract_en: FIR filter is a basic process unit which is widely used in digital signal.Aiming at the problems in designing the FIR filter using software and hardware,a scheme is proposed which designs a FIR filter of strictly linear phase with window functions in Matlab and runs it on FPGA parallelly with high speed.The orders and coefficients of the filter may flexibly be adjusted to apply it in various applications.It is shown that the scheme is effective for designing high speed digital filter through programming and debugging.
abstract_zh: FIR滤波器是数字信号中广泛使用的基本处理单元。针对FIR滤波器软硬件设计中存在的问题，提出了一种在Matlab中设计带有窗函数的严格线性相位FIR滤波器并在FPGA上高速并行运行的方案，该方案可以灵活调整滤波器的阶数和系数，以适应各种应用。通过编程和调试表明，该方案对于设计高速数字滤波器是有效的。

title: Design and Manufacturing of Small Area On-Chip-Antenna (OCA) for RFID Tags
title_en: Design and Manufacturing of Small Area On-Chip-Antenna (OCA) for RFID Tags
title_zh: RFID 标签小面积片上天线 (OCA) 的设计和制造
abstract_en: In this paper, OCA has been discussed in detail in design methodologies under various scenario, fabrication development and finally the experimental characterization results. This paper emphasizes exploring the co-design of OCA with reader's antenna, tag's circuit and the fabrication technology. The matching-area on the Smith Chart has been proposed to predict and guide the matching network design for OCA. As an example, OCA has been successfully demonstrated on a 2.45 GHz RFID tag chip with area of 1times 0.5 mm2

abstract_en: The MC-DS-CDMA system, OFDM technology is applied in, has some good properties, such as high-speed transmission and restraining multi-path interference. However it has some shortcomings. Lots of resource of frequency is used in this system. Because traditional spreading spectral sequence doesn’t have good property of auto-correlation and cross-correlation in the meantime, it leads to multi-access interference. In this paper, a new communication system of MC-DS-CDMA system using modified complementary sequences as spreading spectral sequence will be proposed to solve those problems. Based on the theory of complementary sequences and OND, the concept of dummy chip is led in. According to the algorithm of dummy chips generation, the whole frame data will be processed and becomes the extended frame which is also called modified complementary sequence. The dummy chips in the extended frame become an undisturbed window. When received data is carried on the particular correlating computation of complementary sequence in the undisturbed window, the primitive transmitted data will be restored correctly. The performance of MC-DS-CDMA system based on modified complementary sequence has been analyzed and simulated. The result of simulation proved that this measure is proper and feasible. With the quotation of this technology, the system can efficiently eliminate multi-path interference and decrease multi-access interference to a low level under the condition of using less subcarriers relatively.

title: A narrowband multi-ary FSK transmission principle using sampling function waveform modulation
title_en: A narrowband multi-ary FSK transmission principle using sampling function waveform modulation
title_zh: 采用采样函数波形调制的窄带多进制FSK传输原理
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Spread Spectrum Techniques and Applications (ISSSTA)
abstract_en: Conventional FSK uses shift frequencies of integer times the frame rate. If shift frequencies using non-integers (NIFSK) could be used, the frequency utilization efficiency would improve due to the capability of multi-ary transmission. However, since a framed sequence consisting of NIFSK includes abrupt transients, the waveform suffers from considerable distortion when it is transmitted via a bandlimited path. To solve this problem, we propose sampling function waveform modulation system (SAFWM). SAFWM uses a modified sampling function waveform that is immune to intersymbol interference generated in the process of conveying each sampled value of an FSK signal. The transmission bandwidth is only slightly larger than that of zero to the maximum shift frequency. At the receiver, the sampled values are restored by correlation detection with the same waveforms, and are transformed into the original FSK. To accurately restore a waveform of transmitted NIFSK signals, frame extension is introduced. Distortionless transmission performed with this method is confirmed by computer simulation. This principle can be applied not only for FSK/PSK but also for FSK-SS (spread spectrum) and FH-SS, resulting in improving their frequency utilization efficiencies.

title: Transmission efficiency of code shift keying
title_en: Transmission efficiency of code shift keying
title_zh: 码移键控的传输效率
abstract_en: The authors determine the frequency utilization efficiency of code shift keying (CSK) under practical design parameters. If an ideal bit-position discriminating function for M-sequence is used, the information conveyed by one frame of M chips (the length of M-sequence) increases to log/sub 2/M bits. This is the principle of CSK. However, it is more vulnerable to noise than the conventional spread spectrum system, DS-BPSK. The authors compare the transmission capacities of CSK and BPSK under identical conditions of receiving signal power, Gaussian and interfering noise power, frequency bandwidth, and bit error rate. The result shows that CSK is capable of transmitting 2/spl sim/4.5 times the capacity of BPSK.>
abstract_zh: 作者确定了实际设计参数下码移键控（CSK）的频率利用效率。如果使用M序列的理想比特位置判别函数，则一帧M码片所传送的信息(M序列的长度)增加到log/sub 2/M比特。这就是CSK的原理。然而，它比传统的扩频系统 DS-BPSK 更容易受到噪声的影响。作者比较了在接收信号功率、高斯和干扰噪声功率、频率带宽和误码率相同的条件下CSK和BPSK的传输能力。结果表明，CSK 的传输能力是 BPSK 的 2/spl sim/4.5 倍。>
